description.text: This 3-bedroom, 2-bath townhouse in North Austin offers a spacious layout with wood-style flooring, plenty of natural light, and an open living and dining area. The layout provides plenty of room to relax, entertain, or set up a home office. The kitchen features ample cabinet storage, modern appliances, and a gas stove. The primary bedroom includes an en suite bathroom, while the two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for roommates, guests, or additional living space. Both bathrooms feature updated finishes. The community also has an on-site laundry room for added convenience. Conveniently located near The Domain, Q2 Stadium, and Burnet Road, the property is close to a variety of restaurants, shopping, and entertainment. With easy access to MoPac, Highway 183, and I-35, getting around Austin is convenient. Pets are welcome! With three bedrooms, two bathrooms, gas cooking, and on-site laundry, this townhouse offers a practical option for anyone looking for a home in North Austin.
